positive: The dashboard takes four seconds to load.

negative: Write a blog post about Core Web Vitals.

behaviors.context: A TanStack Start app. The `/reports` route feels slow in production. The project already has Lighthouse CI configured.
must: Measures a baseline with the existing tooling before changing code
Measures production output or representative conditions rather than a dev build
Reports before and after results with the tested conditions and any remaining uncertainty
mustNot: Removes a visual or feature to improve the metric without explaining the tradeoff

behaviors.context: `monaco-editor` is imported from a shared layout component, so every route ships it. Only `/editor` uses it.
behaviors.prompt: Fix the bundle so only the editor page pays for Monaco.
must: Uses the framework's route loading or code-splitting mechanism
Checks both the editor page and an unrelated page afterward
Accounts for the cost of deferred loading on the editor interaction itself
mustNot: Adds a benchmark framework when existing tooling suffices

behaviors.context: The theme switcher runs a `useEffect` that loops over about forty elements and sets inline `style.backgroundColor` and `style.color` on each when the theme changes. Users report jank when switching.
must: Moves theme values to CSS custom properties and the cascade
Keeps JavaScript responsible only for the user's preference and its persistence
Verifies the switch is still visually correct afterward
mustNot: Removes the theme switcher or reduces its functionality
